question: In which Five-Year Plan were Removal of Poverty (Garibi Hatao) and Self-Reliance declared as major plan objectives?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Fifth five-year Plan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fifth Five-Year Plan**

 
 
• The Fifth Five-Year Plan of India, which spanned from 1974 to 1979, emphasized the goals of Removal of Poverty (Garibi Hatao) and Self-Reliance.
 
• These objectives were in response to the needs of the time, aiming to address widespread poverty and improve the country's economic independence.
 
• The slogan "Garibi Hatao" became a rallying cry for the then Prime Minister Indira Gandhi's government, symbolizing a commitment to elevating the living standards of India's poor.
 
• The plan also focused on agricultural and rural development, recognising their importance in achieving the twin goals of poverty removal and self-reliance.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 1) Eighth Five-Year Plan
 Focused on the development of human resources including education, health, and employment.
 
 

 2) Seventh Five-Year Plan
 Emphasized policies and programs aimed at food, work, and productivity.
 
 

 4) Sixth Five-Year Plan
 Marked a return to the Five-Year Plan model and focused on poverty alleviation and technological self-reliance.
